hyperparameters.name: COCO scale jitter shorter image side

methods.name: Panoptic FPN
methods.description: Measures performance using PQ, capturing both recognition and segmentation quality for stuff and thing categories in a unified manner.

methods.name: Mask R-CNN 1 × training setting
methods.description: Training setting with scale jitter with shorter image side in [640, 800].

methods.name: post-processing merging procedure
methods.description: Procedure applied to the outputs of the semantic and instance branches prior to PQ evaluation.

methods.name: ResNet-50 Semantic FPN
methods.description: semantic segmentation branch with ResNet-50 backbone

methods.name: Mask R-CNN
methods.description: instance segmentation baseline network combined with semantic segmentation branch

methods.name: multi-scale inference
methods.description: Used at test time along with balancing the class distribution

methods.name: semantic segmentation branch
methods.description: Upsampling module with two 3x3 conv layers and ReLU before bilinear upscaling to final resolution, with concatenated features

methods.name: ResNet/ResNeXt backbone
methods.description: Pre-FPN backbone pre-trained on ImageNet with batch normalization, replaced with a fixed channel-wise affine transformation during fine-tuning.

methods.name: Panoptic inference post-processing
methods.description: Post-processing procedure to resolve overlaps between different instances by confidence score, prioritize instances over semantic segmentation, and filter stuff regions labeled 'other' or under an area threshold.

methods.name: ResNet-50
methods.description: Backbone architecture used in separate and joint networks.

methods.name: ResNet-101
methods.description: Backbone architecture used in Panoptic FPN to balance computational budget.

methods.name: Combined loss training
methods.description: Combines instance and semantic losses together during each gradient update.

methods.name: Alternating loss training
methods.description: Alternates instance and semantic losses on each iteration.

methods.name: FPN
methods.description: architecture where FPN channels are grouped into two sets, and each task uses one of the two features sets as its input

methods.name: Loss re-weighting
methods.description: Balancing total instance segmentation loss and semantic segmentation loss using the formulation L=λi(Lc+Lb+Lm) + λsLs.

methods.name: FPN for semantic and instance segmentation
methods.description: A single-network baseline using Feature Pyramid Networks (FPN) compatible with Mask R-CNN to perform both instance and semantic segmentation.
